allowed_tools.description: Function names the workflow permits. Omit to skip the catalog check.

screening.description: A context screen report for the same request.

candidate.description: A candidate probe report for the same request.

shadow.description: A shadow probe report for the same request.

include_excerpts.description: Request captured text and tested values when enabled by the host.

nexusweave.required_sources.description: One workflow requirement. All named source IDs in at least one alternative must have validated request fragments. Also accepts the object's JSON encoding.

attributes.description: Captured GenAI inputs and optional NexusWeave context metadata. Preserve the original inference JSON as a string in nexusweave.request.body. Optional nexusweave.prefill.probe carries a first-token edit report returned by probe-prefill.
